convert_metadata_to_beta: convert a list of metadata key-value pairs to beta bytes format using the beta function
convert_beta_metadata_to_string: convert beta bytes metadata back to string format using the unbeta function
encode_single_metadatum_to_beta: encode a single metadata key-value pair into beta bytes using _beta_metadatum
decode_single_beta_metadatum: decode a single beta metadatum key-value pair back to string using _metadatum
create_metadatum_namedtuple: create a _Metadatum namedtuple with key and value fields for gRPC metadata
